name: Giorgi Mamardashvili

career_stints.note: Loan from Dinamo Tbilisi, Georgian top flight; helped the club avoid relegation.

La Liga aggregate across all Valencia seasons (initial loan from 7 June 2021, later made permanent), per Transfermarkt career-by-competition fetch 2026-08-10. That same fetch returned a goals-conceded figure ('10 goals conceded' across 127 games) that is almost certainly a data-extraction artifact -- implausible for the sample size -- so it was not used. His final Valencia season (2024/25) is separately confirmed at 34 La Liga appearances, 8 clean sheets, 92 saves.

All-competitions: 19 starts + 1 substitute appearance, 3 clean sheets, 34 goals conceded. Premier League split specifically: 10 apps, 868 minutes, 2 clean sheets, 17 conceded, 65.4% save percentage -- rotation/backup role behind Alisson.

notes: Liverpool's summer-2025 signing from Valencia. His 2025/26 Liverpool season was a genuine backup/rotation role (10 PL starts, 868 minutes) that falls short of a clean single-competition 900+ minute sample, but the full-season body of work across all competitions (19-20 starts total) was judged substantial enough to use liverpool_recent_minutes rather than reaching back to Valencia -- flagged as a borderline call, hence the moderate (0.6) confidence.

2024/25 Valencia season (34 La Liga apps, 8 clean sheets, 92 saves, last season as an undisputed #1) used as playstyle_metrics.source_season instead of the Liverpool backup season, following the same judgment-call precedent used for Isak's profile (see data/player_profiles/isak_alexander.json). Season minutes for that Valencia campaign were not confirmed from an accessible source, so playstyle_metrics.minutes is omitted rather than estimated from apps x 90.

Georgian academy/parent-club stint at Dinamo Tbilisi and a subsequent Locomotive Tbilisi loan (approx. 2019/20-2021, including a notable Europa League run that drew Valencia's scouting interest) are documented but no appearance counts were confirmed -- omitted from career_stints rather than guessed.
No current injury found as of 2026-08-10 research.
Sources: transfermarkt.us (career-by-competition fetch 2026-08-10), footystats.org, livescore.com, thisisanfield.com, teamtalk.com, valenciacf.com -- via web search/fetch 2026-08-10.
